name: Topic 37: Common micronutrient deficiencies in India

rules.if: sex is female and age is between 12 and 49
rules.then: Add iron and folate to the watch list; show food-first tips and the message 'Many women in India fall short of iron. Worth checking with your doctor.' Never state that the user is anaemic.

rules.if: diet is vegetarian, Jain or vegan
rules.then: Add vitamin B12, iron, zinc, calcium and omega-3 to the watch list; B12 message suggests talking to a doctor about testing and fortified foods.

rules.if: dairy servings per day is below 2
rules.then: Add calcium and riboflavin to the watch list; suggest ragi, sesame, milk, curd or paneer within the user's diet pattern.

rules.if: sun exposure is low (mostly indoors or fully covered)
rules.then: Add vitamin D to the watch list; word as 'commonly low in India'; do not suggest a dose; point to a doctor for a 25(OH)D test.
rules.source: IJEM 2017 systematic review; ICMR-NIN 2020 15 ug/day RDA

rules.if: tea or coffee is taken with main meals
rules.then: Show tip to keep tea or coffee at least one hour away from iron-rich meals and add iron and zinc to the watch list.
Add zinc, B12, folate and iron to the watch list; show a parent or doctor message.
rules.source: CNNS 2016-18 (AJCN zinc, PMC10346745 B12 and folate)

rules.if: user is pregnant, planning pregnancy or lactating
rules.then: Set requires_doctor_input true; show only a generic 'talk to your doctor or ANC provider about iron, folic acid, B12 and iodine' message; never suggest doses.
Add iodine to the watch list and suggest iodised salt (ask a doctor first for thyroid disease).

rules.if: user reports fatigue, breathlessness, numbness, hair loss or bone pain
rules.then: Show 'These symptoms have many causes; please see a doctor' and do not attach a nutrient label.
rules.source: General clinical guidance; not medical advice

rules.then: Include the line 'General information, not medical advice. Labs such as CBC, ferritin, 25(OH)D, B12 and TSH are ordered and read by a doctor.'

mergeMethod.rules: union (newest wording of the same rule)
